name: Woolybit · Gremlet #25
description:
A woolly bear caterpillar. The width of its orange band predicts the winter, supposedly.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Woolybit in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
